author: HR agent
text: Employee is a contractor. According to policy, contractors can have at most read access (or write if they have advanced training), and never admin. Since the request is for admin, I recommend the maximum allowed level for a contractor, which is read (assuming no advanced training is on record).

author: Security agent
text: Employee is a contractor with basic security training. Policy states contractors can have at most read access (or write if they have advanced training) and can never have admin access. Since the request for admin exceeds the policy limit for a contractor, I recommend granting 'read' access.

author: Security agent
text: Employee is a contractor with basic security training. According to policy, contractors can only have read access unless they have advanced security training. Therefore, I recommend downgrading the requested write access to read access.
